summary: Correction: DeepSeek-V4.1 decode drift is not fixed; the compressor-ring change from beta 6e8298a1 had no effect and is removed
compatibility: No user action required. Output is the same as with the previous betas.
details: The note "Keep DeepSeek-V4.1 compressor state across decode steps past the ring size" (vllm #926/#927) was wrong: ring groups do not use the slot mapping that change edited, so it never ran. Measured decode-vs-prefill divergence over 2K tokens was the same with and without it. The drift remains under investigation.
